chk_identity_webhook_events_processed_at.name: chk_identity_webhook_events_processed_at
chk_identity_webhook_events_processed_at.value:
(
        ("identity_webhook_events"."status" = 'processed' AND "identity_webhook_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_webhook_events"."status" <> 'processed' AND "identity_webhook_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)
      )

chk_organization_invitations_lifecycle.name: chk_organization_invitations_lifecycle
chk_organization_invitations_lifecycle.value:
(
        ("organization_invitations"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired') AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("organization_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("organization_invitations"."status" = 'revoked' AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "organization_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

chk_leads_conversion.name: chk_leads_conversion
chk_leads_conversion.value:
(
        ("leads"."status" = 'converted' AND "leads"."converted_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("leads"."status" <> 'converted' AND "leads"."converted_organization_id" IS NULL AND "leads"."converted_at" IS NULL)
      )

chk_organization_memberships_timestamps.name: chk_organization_memberships_timestamps
chk_organization_memberships_timestamps.value:
(
        ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'active' AND "organization_memberships"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'pending' AND "organization_memberships"."activated_at" IS NULL AND "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'revoked' AND "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

uq_organizations_country_tax_normalized.name: uq_organizations_country_tax_normalized
uq_organizations_country_tax_normalized.where: "organizations"."country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."tax_id_normalized" IS NOT NULL

chk_organizations_tax_fields.name: chk_organizations_tax_fields
chk_organizations_tax_fields.value:
(
        ("organizations"."tax_id" IS NULL AND "organizations"."tax_id_normalized" IS NULL)
        OR
        (
          "organizations"."tax_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "organizations"."tax_id_normalized" IS NOT NULL
          AND "organizations"."country_code" IS NOT NULL
          AND btrim("organizations"."tax_id_normalized") <> ''
        )
      )

chk_deliverables_approval.name: chk_deliverables_approval
chk_deliverables_approval.value:
(
        ("deliverables"."status" = 'approved' AND "deliverables"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "deliverables"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("deliverables"."status" <> 'approved' AND "deliverables"."approved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "deliverables"."approved_at" IS NULL)
      )

chk_project_members_revocation.name: chk_project_members_revocation
chk_project_members_revocation.value:
(
        ("project_members"."status" = 'active' AND "project_members"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "project_members"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("project_members"."status" = 'revoked' AND "project_members"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_members"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

chk_project_milestones_completed_at.name: chk_project_milestones_completed_at
chk_project_milestones_completed_at.value:
(
        ("project_milestones"."status" = 'completed' AND "project_milestones"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("project_milestones"."status" <> 'completed' AND "project_milestones"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      )

chk_tasks_context_organization.name: chk_tasks_context_organization
chk_tasks_context_organization.value:
(
        ("tasks"."project_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."organization_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        (num_nonnulls("tasks"."project_id", "tasks"."ticket_id") = 1 AND "tasks"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

chk_tickets_project_requires_organizatio.name: chk_tickets_project_requires_organization
chk_tickets_project_requires_organizatio.value: "tickets"."project_id" IS NULL OR "tickets"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

chk_tickets_resolution.name: chk_tickets_resolution
chk_tickets_resolution.value:
(
        "tickets"."status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')
        OR
        ("tickets"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("tickets"."resolution") <> '' AND "tickets"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

chk_tickets_closed_at.name: chk_tickets_closed_at
chk_tickets_closed_at.value:
(
        ("tickets"."status" = 'closed' AND "tickets"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("tickets"."status" <> 'closed' AND "tickets"."closed_at" IS NULL)
      )
